subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` wait and replay an accepted disconnected Gateway run before retaining the existing automatic isolated embedded fallback when recovery is exhausted?
rationale: Recovery-first changes the published behavior, latency, and result source after an ambiguous disconnect; the linked canonical issue remains open for this user-facing policy choice.

options.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
options.body: Wait and cache-replay the accepted Gateway run first, then preserve the current fresh-session embedded fallback only when recovery cannot establish an outcome.

options.title: Keep immediate fallback
options.body: Retain current main’s immediate isolated embedded fallback and substantially narrow or close this recovery-first branch.

options.title: Fail closed after exhaustion
options.body: Require an explicit opt-in rerun after an unresolved recovery, with an updated CLI contract and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Wait and cache-replay the accepted Gateway run first, then preserve the current fresh-session embedded fallback only when recovery cannot establish an outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged current fallback containment behavior and are the clearest history-backed routing candidate for its successor contract.
